answer: Bind each identity to real hardware, not a keyfile. To claim rewards, an agent must present remote attestation from a genuine TPM or confidential enclave, proving its key lives in a discrete physical device: one device, one mouth to feed. A software attacker can clone ten thousand keys, but an orchard of identities needs an orchard of chips. Each puppet costs real silicon, and any device certifying many identities slides off the jade of trust onto a flagged ledge. Rented enclaves multiply the bill, never the take.
